name: Line Graph (Probe)
description: A short animated line graph with a heading and a counter, drawn in HTML and SVG. Lab pack that proves the html-capture renderer.

cautions: A probe of the renderer, not a look to publish: it stays in lab.

provenance.notes: Only the approach was taken: an HTML page with a deterministic renderFrame(frame), captured frame by frame in headless Chromium and piped into ffmpeg. No file, template or code was copied; adapting its templates is Phase 3.

provenance.ref: venturazz/venstudio docs/plans/style-system.md (Phase 2: renderer framework and html-capture)
provenance.notes: Written for VenStudio as the first html-capture pack. Template code in render/ is original.

curation.ref: venturazz/venstudio-styles CI, job html-capture (branch feat/html-capture): capture-html renders fixtures/payload.json with Chrome Headless Shell
curation.notes: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 6 s (180 frames), H.264 yuv420p; captions burned by ffmpeg with captionStyle. The same render runs in venstudio CI (apps/worker/html-capture-render.test.ts) through the real render-video path with the narration and qc-video.
